rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The 2017 organisational election programme, signed by Central Election Authority member Madhusudan Mistry on 06-06-2017, schedules in Phase IV (16 September to 15 October 2017) the election of PCC office-bearers and AICC members and the election of the Congress President.
